description: 140 GravityZone Public API methods as commands, plus fleet health, billing and incident views across child companies.

novel_features.name: Fleet health rollup
novel_features.description: One ranked table of every child company's unmanaged, outdated, unscanned, policy-not-applied and isolated endpoints, saved as a dated snapshot.

novel_features.name: Cross-tenant incident queue
novel_features.description: Open EDR/XDR incidents across all child companies, ranked by severity and age with unassigned and SLA-breach flags.

novel_features.name: Partner tree
novel_features.description: Your own company plus every child company and sub-partner under it as one flat list with ids, type, parent and depth.

novel_features.name: Billing table
novel_features.description: Per-company billable usage for a month with own share after the child rollup, month-over-month seat swings, and flags wherever a needed fetch failed.

novel_features.name: RMM coverage gap
novel_features.description: Joins an RMM device export to GravityZone inventory to list devices with no agent, discovered-but-unmanaged machines, and agents the RMM does not know.

novel_features.name: Fleet changes
novel_features.description: What changed between saved fleet health snapshots (needs at least two): new and removed endpoints, newly unmanaged, outdated or isolated machines, policy flips.

novel_features.name: Cross-tenant threat correlation
novel_features.description: The same quarantined file (SHA256) seen at two or more companies in a window, and which of those companies already blocklist it.

novel_features.name: Fleet-wide endpoint locator
novel_features.description: Find a machine by hostname, IP, MAC or label across every child company and get its endpoint id and company.
